description:
Send a WhatsApp message (text or media).
Actions:
- text:  { to, text, reply_to? }
- media: { to, type ('image'|'video'|'audio'|'document'|'sticker'),
           media_url | media_base64, caption?, filename?, mimetype? }

`to` accepts either a JID ('5511999999999@s.whatsapp.net', '<id>@g.us') or
a plain phone (digits, country code included). For groups always use the
'<id>@g.us' JID — get it from whatsapp_groups.

Result: `sent:true` + `delivery:"accepted_by_server"` means WhatsApp's server
accepted the message (it has an id). It is NOT a read/delivery receipt from the
recipients' phones. If the message did not go out, the call fails with the reason.

[Flattened action: media]
name: whatsapp_send_media
